task: P1.1 (issue #55): penalties per row in batch windows - solo-vs-batch token parity
engine: engine/strata built at e940051b (fix included), model Swift-1.5 GSQ IQ3_XXS
hardware: 4x MI50 (gfx906); batch arm used --gpu 1; 125 GiB RAM, all other engines down

arms.name: sampled (unseeded, first run of run-p1.1-penalty.sh)
arms.result: 3/4 slots DIFFER - explained by the arm, not by #55: an unseeded request takes a fresh steady_clock-keyed seed (generate.cpp:11854), so solo and batch are two different runs

arms.name: D: sampled, no penalty, unseeded (discriminator)
arms.result: 3/4 DIFFER, one at token 0 - no penalty involved: sampled solo-vs-batch is not comparable without a seed (pre-existing engine behavior, not caused by #55)

arms.name: E: sampled + penalty, seed=1234 (the parity witness)
arms.result: 4/4 slots IDENTICAL to solo - a seeded sampled request replays token-identical in a batch slot WITH penalties in play

arms.name: greedy + penalty
arms.result: 4/4 slots IDENTICAL to solo (greedy draws no random numbers, so this arm is seed-free)

arms.name: H: strong penalty seeded (confirmatory)
arms.result: 4/4 slots IDENTICAL to solo - at rp=1.8 over 4x64 tokens a batch ignoring the penalty could not track solo, so the batch sampler demonstrably applies it

cpu_gates.build: build-906 incremental green (21 s), strata linked
cpu_gates.ctest: 54 tests; fail-set {split_lend, mmvq_il, verify_parity, ple_parity} equals the clean parent's A/B under the same GPU contention (stash/rebuild/rerun/pop); re-run 2026-10-21 with FREE VRAM (all engines down): the same 4 fail in 139 s - they are the documented baseline failures on this tree, not contention and not this change

conclusion: Batch windows apply each row's penalties (#55): seeded sampled parity 4/4 WITH penalties (E at rp=1.1 and H at rp=1.8), greedy-penalty parity 4/4, control 4/4. The unseeded sampled difference is the engine's by-design random seed (steady_clock, generate.cpp:11854), witnessed independent of penalties (arm D). Pre-fix the batch sampler zeroed penalty_last_n (verify.cpp sample_rows), so a batched penalised request sampled the unpenalised distribution; E could not track solo there.
